greatswordAnimation: Use-case: stylized-concept. Original production artwork for AshenSpire, a dark medieval fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Painterly realism, strong readable silhouettes, weathered charcoal iron, restrained antique gold edging, muted burgundy cloth, subtle ash, sophisticated hand-painted game art. No text, lettering, logo, watermark, UI, border, or contact sheet. Create a production sprite animation atlas for the referenced Reaver knight wielding a TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD. Preserve exactly the same pointed black closed helmet, gold trim, burgundy cape and armor proportions. Transparent background. Landscape canvas 1536x1152. STRICT GRID: 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, no drawn grid or labels. Eleven full-body poses, last cell empty. Each character faces RIGHT, stays entirely within its own cell with clear transparent gutters, equal anatomical scale, boots on same local baseline. Both hands on greatsword during attack and defend. Row 1 cells left to right: (1) basic ready stance sword tilted upward; (2) attack frame 1 anticipation crouch; (3) attack frame 2 windup sword back above left shoulder; (4) attack frame 3 raised overhead maximum windup. Row 2: (5) attack frame 4 initiating downward swing; (6) attack frame 5 impact extension sword diagonally down to right; (7) attack frame 6 follow-through low right with torso rotation; (8) attack frame 7 recovery drawing blade back into ready stance. Row 3: (9) defend braced with broad blade held diagonally across torso; (10) hurt recoil shoulders back knees bent still gripping sword; (11) cast, sword planted beside knight in one hand while free hand projects a small gold spell; (12) EMPTY TRANSPARENT CELL. Seven attack frames depict ONE fluid overhead cleave, not seven different attacks. No duplicate poses, no scenery, no shadows on ground, no detached effects, no cropped swords. Make full body each cell smaller if necessary to fit entire weapon. Clear anatomy and distinct pose changes at game sprite scale.

rogueAnimation: Use-case: stylized-concept. Original production artwork for AshenSpire, a dark medieval fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. No text, lettering, logo, watermark, UI, border, or contact sheet. Create ONE production sprite atlas, 4 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells, 1536x1152 canvas, genuinely transparent background. Each full figure and entire weapon must fit inside its own cell with 30px clear margins, no overlap, no labels or drawn grid. Same character design and anatomical scale in every pose; faces RIGHT; common boot baseline per cell. Read row-major. Cells: 1 basic stance; 2 ATK-01 anticipation; 3 ATK-02 windup; 4 ATK-03 maximum windup; 5 ATK-04 release; 6 ATK-05 impact extension; 7 ATK-06 follow-through; 8 ATK-07 recovery; 9 DEF braced defend; 10 HURT recoil; 11 CAST magical casting; 12 PORTRAIT a detailed chest-up bust of same character, framed with margin. Seven attack frames form ONE continuous action. No scenery, ground shadow or cropped anatomy. Character: Rogue from supplied reference, tattered charcoal hood, face shadowed with only lower nose and mouth visible, dark leather coat, muted olive cloth, brown belt, slim agile proportions. Keep muted reference palette rather than Reaver burgundy. RIGHT hand a straight steel dagger; LEFT hand a shorter steel parrying dagger with swept quillons. Both weapons visible throughout. Attack sequence is a low crouching right-hand dagger thrust, left-hand parrying blade stays near chest as guard, anticipation then coil then forward thrust then follow-through then retract. Defend crosses both daggers. Hurt recoils with both blades lowered. Cast holds both daggers gathered in left hand and a small pale blue spell in the right. Portrait includes hood and shoulder equipment, no spell. Same figure and equipment for all eleven poses.
